newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias falls 37.7 pct on debt moratorium.
newsitem.headline: Victorias falls 37.7 pct on debt moratorium.

text.p: Victorias Milling Co Inc fell 37.78 percent to 2.80 pesos in early trade on news it had a debt problem and had secured a moratorium on loans amounting to 4.4 billion pesos ($167 million), brokers said on Friday.
Victorias all-time low of 2.80 peso was hit amidst a moderate turnover of 71,000 shares.
"The market is selling Victorias because of its bad debts," Ramon Borja, analyst of Dharmala Securities, said.
He said unless the company was able to solve its financial woes, it would remain a sell despite the respite given by the banks.

Victorias officials blamed the company's financial troubles on the steep fall in Philippine sugar prices. Some analysts said it could have been aggravated by its aggressive expansion programme which was mainly financed through bank loans.
Other sugar companies such as Central Azucarera de Don Pedro, Central Azucarera de Carlota, Central Azucarera de Tarlac, and Central Azucarera de Pilar, were untraded in early Friday session.
